narration: Your bonus landed in month {fork_month}, and at dinner your father mentioned your cousin's missed deadline. You chose {real_choice}, and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. The money was furthest apart that same month, when the ghost held {widest_gap}. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. At month {end_month} the ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}. The ghost's room to ride out a lost salary ended {safety_gap}.
